stories.title: State bill could end tax breaks for new Michigan data centers
stories.dek: A proposed state law would limit local tax abatements that data-center developers have used to cut costs. Michigan towns have relied on those breaks to lure projects promising jobs and investment. Residents could see higher local taxes or fewer incentives if the legislation passes.
stories.source_title: Data center tax breaks could falter if state legislation is passed - WILX

stories.title: John James backed bills stripping local say on data centers
stories.dek: A new report shows the Michigan congressman voted four times against letting cities and townships control data-center projects. The votes matter because many communities now face large proposals with big power and water demands. Voters in competitive districts may weigh the issue in the midterms.
stories.source_title: New Report: John James Voted 4 Times To Ban Local Control on Data Centers - Michigan Democratic Party

stories.title: UM Ypsilanti Data Center Overrides Local Opposition Like OpenAI in Saline
stories.dek: Residents say the University is spending a billion in public funds on a nuclear-research facility the community rejected, following the same pattern of power overriding protests seen with OpenAI’s Saline project.

stories.title: Michigan city claims new rules kill developer’s data-center lawsuit
stories.dek: Local officials say updated zoning rules make a pending lawsuit over a blocked data-center project irrelevant. The developer had sued after the city rejected its plans. The outcome will decide whether the company can still force the project forward or must start over.
stories.source_title: Mich. City Says New Rules Moot Developer's Data Center Suit - Law360

stories.title: Ionia residents get first look at data center power and water risks
stories.dek: Ionia is holding a proactive public meeting to discuss potential data center projects before any proposals arrive. Residents 30 miles away care because new facilities could strain local electricity rates and groundwater supplies. The session gives the community a chance to shape rules early rather than react after plans are filed.
stories.source_title: Ionia to host ‘proactive’ meeting on data centers - Yahoo

stories.title: Township seeks court win to uphold power-hungry campus rejection
stories.dek: A township is asking a judge to throw out a developer’s suit after rejecting a proposed campus. The case centers on whether local zoning can block large projects that need heavy power and cooling. A ruling could affect how other Oakland County communities handle similar applications.
stories.source_title: Oakland County suburb asks judge to dismiss data center developer’s lawsuit - Crain's Detroit

stories.title: St. Clair County residents to hear data center health risks at upcoming workshop
stories.dek: A public session will focus on potential noise, air, and water impacts from proposed data centers in the area. Locals worry about strain on power grids and drinking supplies if projects advance. The discussion could shape future zoning fights in this southeast Michigan county.
stories.source_title: Data center workshop to examine potential health concerns in St. Clair County - Times Herald

stories.title: Hyperscale Data Halts Bitcoin Mining at Michigan Site to Launch AI Data Center Operations
stories.dek: Company shuts down all miners effective Sept. 1 under a master services agreement projected to generate $1.2 billion, with expansion options potentially reaching $3 billion using up to 20% of the facility's 340 MW capacity.

stories.title: Rep. James pushes local control over Michigan data center rules
stories.dek: The congressman argues cities and townships should decide data center rules themselves. Past federal votes by James sought to limit exactly that local authority. The shift could reshape how projects win approvals across the state.
stories.source_title: As James pushes local control on data centers, past congressional votes sought to limit just that - Michigan Advance

stories.title: Consumers Energy starts Cherry Street work to bolster grid for rising loads
stories.dek: The utility is upgrading electric infrastructure in a project tied to surging demand. Data centers and other large users are pushing the system harder. West Michigan customers may see more construction and eventual rate impacts.
stories.source_title: Consumers Energy: Construction to commence on Cherry Street for upgrades to electric infrastructure - wzzm13.com

stories.title: Runestad pushes to end sales-tax breaks for new data centers
stories.dek: The Michigan senator wants to repeal exemptions that shield hyperscale projects from state taxes. The move could shift more costs onto residents and local governments. Lawmakers will weigh revenue gains against job and investment arguments.
stories.source_title: Runestad seeks to repeal data center sales and use tax exemptions - Michigan Senate Republicans

national.title: Data centers advance rapidly as regulators scramble for rules
national.dek: Across the U.S., officials race to impose guardrails on power-hungry facilities while communities push back on incentives and impacts.
